sources.entry: Python for Everybody: Exploring Data in Python 3 by Charles Severance

summary.name: Python for Everybody
summary.one_liner: An free, Creative Commons-licensed introductory Python programming book by Charles Severance, aimed at informatics and data analysis.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an informatics-oriented introduction to programming in Python, focused on using Python to solve data analysis problems. It links to sample code and data files for the book. It lists translations into Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Greek, Hindi/Urdu, Persian, Turkish and other languages, along with some free PDF editions. Chapters 2-10 are adapted from the open book "Think Python" by Allen B. Downey and Jeff Elkner. The content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.
notable: Informatics-oriented approach emphasizing data analysis problems
Free Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licensed book
Multiple translations and a companion course site (py4e.com)
caveats: A printed book is also offered, which is not free
Some free PDF editions are marked as in progress
